name: Belphegor
source:
The Prince's political advisor and Soul Contractor. Though a fallen angel, in Hell he possesses the thick blood of a pure demon aristocrat. He is in need of a human "White Soul", which Prince Zale and Haruka are to collect.

[from [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/akumaouji/akumaouji.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
